propositions: _repair_ticket calls rebuild_snapshot_from_full_log directly instead of routing through rebuild_with_restore, bypassing deleted source restoration
repair_or_plan uses rebuild_with_restore as the composed helper but _repair_ticket does not, creating a divergence between the two repair entry points
rebuild_with_restore lacks a no_commit parameter needed to defer git commits in batch repair loops
_repair_ticket must surface restored source filenames in its disp dict return value to report recovery status
tickets repaired through _repair_ticket with deleted SNAPSHOT sources are not recovered unless the rebuild path is unified with rebuild_with_restore
a second _repair_ticket pass over the same ticket must remain idempotent, restoring nothing and reporting an empty restored list
